## Architecture Overview

The `StorageExtension` interface (named `Extension` in the code) is defined in `jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go`. It currently has `TraceStorageFactory()` and `MetricStorageFactory()` methods. Adding `GetArchiveStorage(ctx context.Context) (tracestorage.Reader, tracestorage.Writer, error)` breaks the `storageExt` implementation and all consumers.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Interface & Implementation

- **`extension.go`** (lines 30-34) — Defines the Extension interface with `TraceStorageFactory()` and `MetricStorageFactory()`. The `storageExt` struct implements this. Adding `GetArchiveStorage()` requires implementation here.
- **`extension_test.go`** — Tests the jaegerstorage extension. Must add tests for the new method.
- **`config.go`** — Configuration for trace and metric backends. May need archive storage config.
- **`factory.go`** — Factory for creating the jaegerstorage extension.

### Jaeger Query Extension (Archive Storage Consumer)

- **`jaegerquery/server.go`** (lines 141-178) — Implements `addArchiveStorage()` and `initArchiveStorage()` that manually call `jaegerstorage.GetTraceStoreFactory()`. Can be refactored to use the new `GetArchiveStorage()` method.
- **`jaegerquery/querysvc/service.go`** (lines 27-30) — Contains `QueryServiceOptions` with `ArchiveTraceReader` and `ArchiveTraceWriter` fields. Compatible with the new method return type.
- **`jaegerquery/querysvc/service_test.go`** — Tests QueryService archive storage usage.

### Other Jaeger Extensions

- **`exporters/storageexporter/exporter.go`** — Calls `jaegerstorage.GetTraceStoreFactory()`. May need updates.
- **`integration/storagecleaner/extension.go`** — Calls `jaegerstorage.GetPurger()`. Uses same factory pattern.
- **`extension/remotestorage/server.go`** — Depends on jaegerstorage.ID and calls `GetTraceStoreFactory()`.

### OTel Collector Contrib

- **`extension/storage/storagetest/`** — Test utilities for OTel storage extensions. Testing pattern examples.
